## Summary

<!-- What changes on the profile page or in the tooling, in two or three sentences. -->

## Type

- [ ] ✨ feat: new section or feature
- [ ] 🐛 fix: bug fix
- [ ] ⚡️ perf: performance
- [ ] ♻️ refactor: no behaviour change
- [ ] ✅ test: tests only
- [ ] 📝 docs: README text or other documentation
- [ ] 🎨 style: formatting only
- [ ] 📦 build: build or dependencies
- [ ] 👷 ci: workflows
- [ ] 🔧 chore: tooling, config
- [ ] ⏪ revert: undo an earlier change
- [ ] 💥 breaking change

## Preview

<!-- README changes: screenshots of the profile page in GitHub's light and dark themes. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint:md && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Works in light and dark; images have alt text
- [ ] No invented facts about the owner
- [ ] The code-reviewer agent passed the branch
- [ ] Dependencies are exact versions, and new ones have the owner's approval
